children: -- Financial 15 Split Corp. ("Financial 15") declares its regular monthly distribution of $0.12570 for each Class A share ($1.51 annualized) and $0.06042 for each Preferred share ($0.725 annually). Distributions are payable October 9, 2026 to shareholders on record as at September 30, 2026.

Since inception Class A shareholders have received a total of $29.20 per share and Preferred shareholders have received a total of $13.50 per share inclusive of this distribution, for a combined total of $42.71.

Financial 15 invests in a high quality portfolio consisting primarily of financial services companies made up of Canadian and U.S. issuers as follows: Bank of Montreal, The Bank of Nova Scotia, Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, Royal Bank of Canada, Toronto-Dominion Bank, National Bank of Canada, Manulife Financial Corporation, Sun Life Financial, Great-West Lifeco, Bank of America, Citigroup Inc., Goldman Sachs Group, JP Morgan Chase & Co. and Wells Fargo & Co.

title: Financial 15 Split Corp. Monthly Dividend Declaration for Class A & Preferred Share
